entities.summary: The largest empire in world history, at its peak in 1920 controlling roughly 25% of the world's land and population. Emerging from maritime competition with Spain and the Netherlands, Britain built a global empire through naval supremacy, trading companies, settler colonialism, and industrial power that reshaped language, law, governance, and culture worldwide.
